_fixture.note: An hour after put-here-device, with location access turned off, the app sends where you are as approximate, and Netlify places the connection in the UK but in no town: the server deletes the phone’s location, has nothing left to keep, forgets the set and answers 400 bad_location in its own words, which the app shows. The Debug builds answer this to a set no other fixture has.
